<translated_code>
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {

    static List<List<Long>> chooset;
    static int R, C;

    static long bit(int x) {
        return 1L << x;
    }

    static long choose(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return chooset.get(n).get(r);
    }

    static void recurse(int L, int N, int a, int na, long req, long excl, long cur, List<Long> sums) {
        if (na > N - L) return;
        else if (L == N) {
            sums.add(cur);
            return;
        }

        long mask = bit(L);
        if ((req & mask) == 0) {
            recurse(L + 1, N, a, na, req, excl, cur, sums);
        }
        if (na > 0 && (excl & mask) == 0) {
            long nxt = cur + choose(a, R - 1) * choose(L - a, R);
            recurse(L + 1, N, a + 1, na - 1, req, excl, nxt, sums);
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        long second;
        Pair(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static Pair solve(String pattern) {
        int N = pattern.length();
        long base = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < R + C; i++) {
            base += choose(i, R - 1) * choose(N - i - 1, R);
        }
        long unfair = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        long trg = 2 * base - choose(N, 2 * R);

        long req = 0, excl = 0;
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (pattern.charAt(i) == 'A') {
                req |= bit(i);
            } else if (pattern.charAt(i) == 'B') {
                excl |= bit(i);
            }
        }

        long[][] dp = new long[R + C + 1][R + C + 1];
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j <= R + C; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= R + C; k++) {
                if (j >= R - 1 && k >= R) break;
                if (j < R + C && pattern.charAt(j + k) != 'B') {
                    dp[j + 1][k] += dp[j][k];
                }
                if (k < R + C && pattern.charAt(j + k) != 'A') {
                    dp[j][k + 1] += dp[j][k];
                }
            }
        }

        int M = N - C;
        List<List<Long>> asums2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            asums2.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int al = R - 1; al <= R + C; al++) {
            List<Long> list = new ArrayList<>();
            recurse(M, N, al, R + C - al, req, excl, 0, list);
            list.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());
            asums2.set(al, list);
        }

        for (int a = R - 1; a <= R + C; a++) {
            for (int b = R; b <= R + C; b++) {
                if (a > R - 1 && b > R) continue;
                if (dp[a][b] == 0) continue;
                int L = a + b;
                for (int l = 0; l <= M - L; l++) {
                    int r = R + C - a - l;
                    if (r > N - M || r < 0) continue;
                    List<Long> sums1 = new ArrayList<>();
                    recurse(L, M, a, l, req, excl, 0, sums1);
                    Collections.sort(sums1);
                    List<Long> sums2 = asums2.get(a + l);
                    int p = 0, q = 0;
                    int p2 = 0, q2 = 0;
                    while (p < sums1.size() && q < sums2.size()) {
                        while (p2 < sums1.size() && sums1.get(p2).equals(sums1.get(p))) p2++;
                        while (q2 < sums2.size() && sums2.get(q2).equals(sums2.get(q))) q2++;
                        long total = 2 * (sums1.get(p) + sums2.get(q));
                        long diff = Math.abs(total - trg);
                        if (diff < unfair) {
                            unfair = diff;
                            ans = 0;
                        }
                        if (diff == unfair) {
                            ans += (long)(p2 - p) * (long)(q2 - q) * dp[a][b];
                        }
                        if (total > trg) {
                            q = q2;
                        } else {
                            p = p2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return new Pair(unfair, ans);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        String pattern = parts[2];

        int N = 2 * (R + C);
        chooset = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                if (j == 0 || j == i) {
                    row.add(1L);
                } else {
                    row.add(chooset.get(i - 1).get(j - 1) + chooset.get(i - 1).get(j));
                }
            }
            chooset.add(row);
        }

        Pair opt = solve(new String(new char[N]).replace('\0', '?'));
        Pair score = solve(pattern);
        if (score.first == opt.first) {
            System.out.println(score.second);
        } else {
            System.out.println("0");
        }
    }
}
